description: Payment gateway audit events, pushed over the Logs Ingestion API.
transformKql: source | where isnotempty(TransactionId) | extend TransactionId = toguid(TransactionId)

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: When the gateway recorded the event.

columns.name: TransactionId
columns.description: Gateway transaction identifier. Declared string in the DCR stream and cast back by the transform, because a stream declaration cannot express guid.

columns.name: SourceIp
columns.description: Caller address. The ip hint lets the portal and Sentinel entity mapping treat it as an address rather than text.

columns.name: GatewayResourceId
columns.description: Resource ID of the gateway instance.

columns.name: AmountMinorUnits
columns.description: Amount in minor units. Integral on purpose: a real would introduce floating-point error into money.

columns.name: Succeeded
columns.description: Whether the gateway authorised the payment.

columns.name: GatewayResponse
columns.description: Full gateway response body, kept as an object so it stays queryable.
